meta.name: keywords
meta.content: robotics, robot, parts, educational robotics, FIRST, FRC, FTC, STEM,

meta.name: description
meta.content: REV Robotics designs, builds and manufactures robotics parts and components used by students for learning about science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM). Our parts are commonly used within the FIRST Robotics Competition and the FIRST Tech Challenge.
